result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. `RegionManagerTest` passes (5 tests, 0 failures).

The change is one query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: `listOpenSupportTicketsInRegion`. I changed its `ORDER BY` to the same `CASE` expression that `listOpenSupportTicketsOfSalesRepCustomers` uses, and updated its Javadoc to match. The only caller is the region overview, so nothing else changes. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before. I did not commit.
